import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_0/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_0/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_0_0 and Source2_0_1 on 'school_name'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0[['school_name']], df1[['school_name', 'reading_score']], on='school_name', how='inner')

# Group by 'school_name' and compute average reading_score
target_df = df_joined.groupby('school_name', as_index=False)['reading_score'].mean()

# Ensure reading_score is float type (it should be by default)
target_df['reading_score'] = target_df['reading_score'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_0/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
